question: Are there any protocol-drift findings from the weekly watch?
sql: SELECT clinic_id, month, measure_id, severity, ROUND(t_rate,3) AS window_rate, ROUND(baseline,3) AS baseline_rate, ROUND(delta,3) AS delta, narrative FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.protocol_watch_findings WHERE finding_type = 'STEP_DRIFT' AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.protocol_watch_findings) ORDER BY delta ASC

question: How many high-A1c triggers were not followed up within 90 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missed_followups FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_protocol_adherence WHERE window_closed AND NOT followup_within_90d

question: How many patients are on the disrupted (handoff) clinic's panels?
sql: SELECT clinic_id, COUNT(*) AS patients FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.panel_roster WHERE is_handoff = true GROUP BY clinic_id

question: Compare Step-3 follow-up before vs after the mid-year transition, disrupted clinic vs rest.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN r.is_handoff THEN 'disrupted clinic' ELSE 'rest' END AS cohort, CASE WHEN p.trigger_ts < DATE'2026-05-15' THEN '1_pre' ELSE '2_post' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS triggers, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.followup_within_90d AS INT)),3) AS followup_rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_protocol_adherence p JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.panel_roster r USING (patient_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

content: This agent answers questions about diabetes care-PROCESS adherence (did the right follow-up happen in time?), distinct from the outcome HEDIS measures. HEDIS-aligned demo, not NCQA-certified.
Two governed metric views: protocol_adherence_metrics (Protocol Step 3) and mad_compliance_metrics (Medication Adherence for Diabetes). Query rates with MEASURE(`<name>`); never SUM/AVG a rate.

Protocol Step 3: after an A1c at/above target, the protocol expects a recheck A1c or a therapy change within 90 days. `Protocol Step 3 Adherence Rate` = followed-up triggers / all triggers. Dimensions: Measurement Year, Clinic, Panel, Adherence Status, Follow-up Type. To answer 'which clinic has the lowest Step-3 adherence', GROUP BY `Clinic` and ORDER BY the rate ascending.
MAD: diabetes patients 18+ with >=2 med fills; adherent = PDC >= 80%. `MAD Adherence Rate` and `Avg PDC`. Dimensions: Measurement Year, Clinic, Panel, Adherence Status, Age Band.

One clinic (CLINIC-08) had a mid-year PCP handoff (panel_pcp_transition) that degraded timely follow-up for a few months then recovered; the effect is confounded with that clinic's higher patient complexity. Use panel_roster.is_handoff to identify the disrupted clinic.

protocol_watch_findings is the weekly protocol-watch log (append-only; filter to the latest as_of). finding_type='STEP_DRIFT' rows flag a clinic-month where Step-3 adherence dropped vs that clinic's own prior baseline (delta < 0, worst = most negative); NO_DRIFT means it held steady.

For patient-level detail use gold_protocol_adherence (one row per high-A1c trigger; a missed follow-up = window_closed AND NOT followup_within_90d; an open window is not yet a miss) and gold_adherence_mad (one row per eligible patient, with pdc). clinic_id / panel_id are on both.

filters.display_name: Step 3 open obligations (window not closed yet)
Step 3 missed (window closed, no recheck in 90 days)

expressions.display_name: Step 3 status (matches the protocol adherence metric view)
sql: CASE WHEN gold_protocol_adherence.followup_within_90d THEN 'MET' WHEN gold_protocol_adherence.window_closed THEN 'NOT_MET' ELSE 'OPEN' END

question: The hop a KPI view can't make: join the drifting clinic to the PCP-transition dimension, before vs after

content:
SELECT CAST(t.transition_date AS STRING) AS transition_date, t.clinic_id, t.change_type, t.recovery_days,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.trigger_ts < t.transition_date THEN CAST(p.followup_within_90d AS INT) END), 3) AS adherence_before,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.trigger_ts >= t.transition_date THEN CAST(p.followup_within_90d AS INT) END), 3) AS adherence_after,
       t.narrative
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.panel_pcp_transition t
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_protocol_adherence p
  ON p.clinic_id = t.clinic_id AND p.window_closed AND p.measurement_year = 2026
GROUP BY ALL

evaluation_note: Gold answer key op_drift_rootcause (hand-verified, MY2026). Expected value: 2026-05-15.

question: Lowest protocol Step-3 adherence year-to-date, closed 90-day windows only (open windows aren't misses yet).

content:
SELECT clinic_id, ROUND(AVG(CAST(followup_within_90d AS INT)), 3) AS step3_adherence_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS closed_obligations
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_protocol_adherence
WHERE measurement_year = 2026 AND window_closed
GROUP BY clinic_id ORDER BY step3_adherence_rate, clinic_id

evaluation_note: Gold answer key op_worst_clinic_annual (hand-verified, MY2026). Expected value: CLINIC-04.

question: Each clinic's trailing-3-month adherence (ending the latest closed month) vs its OWN year-to-date baseline.

content:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT clinic_id, date_trunc('MONTH', trigger_ts) AS m, CAST(followup_within_90d AS INT) AS f
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_protocol_adherence WHERE measurement_year = 2026 AND window_closed),
last AS (SELECT max(m) AS lm FROM c)
SELECT clinic_id,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN m > add_months(lm, -3) THEN f END), 3) AS trailing_3mo,
       ROUND(AVG(f), 3) AS own_baseline,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN m > add_months(lm, -3) THEN f END) - AVG(f), 3) AS drift
FROM c CROSS JOIN last GROUP BY clinic_id ORDER BY drift

evaluation_note: Gold answer key op_clinic_drift (hand-verified, MY2026). Expected value: CLINIC-08.
